_about: Prompts for the generated sounds. Music: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo (tags + bpm + key, lyrics fixed to [Instrumental]); effects and ambience: Stable Audio Open 1.0 (text + negative text). Same models, workflows and sampler settings as D:/genesis-vr/tools/make_audio.py. Plain acoustic/musical description only: no artist, composer, band, film, game or series is named, nothing asks for a style of anything, nothing quotes music. Instrumental only (checked afterwards with tools/voices/asr.py).
neg_clean: music, melody, speech, voice, low quality, hiss, noise, distortion
neg_noisy: music, melody, speech, voice, singing, humming, low quality, distortion
ace_tail: , instrumental, no vocals, no lyrics, no choir, no singing
